messages:
Mira: Heads-up — proposing a small-but-important change to audit event schema to support customer-facing compliance contracts. Need alignment on versioning and migration plan.

Jon: +1, can you summarize the deltas?

Mira: High level: add `actor.ip` (nullable), rename `actor_id` -> `actor.subject_id` (for SSO/robot clarity), remove `legacy_action_code` (deprecated), and add an optional `customer_context` object for customer-visible metadata (only present if customer opts in).

Kei: Quick Q: why rename `actor_id` instead of adding `actor.id`? Backwards compatibility concerns.

Mira: We want explicitness — `subject_id` distinguishes human vs service principal when we add `subject_type` later. But we can support a compatibility alias at ingestion: accept `actor_id` and map to `actor.subject_id` until deprecation window ends.

Olivia: Sounds reasonable. How will this show up to customers? They consume webhook and `audit.log_stream` API — both need the new fields and a version marker.

Mira: Plan: embed `event_schema_version` at top-level (string semver-like, e.g., `1.0.0`, bump to `2.0.0` for breaking renames/removals). Non-breaking adds (like `actor.ip`) can be minor bumps. Migration route: 1) Produce v2 events in parallel behind a feature flag; 2) Validate with internal consumers; 3) Offer a customer preview opt-in for webhooks and API; 4) Deprecate v1 after 90 days notice + docs.

Jon: 90 days seems short for enterprise customers. Recommend 180 days deprecation notice for breaking changes.

ProductOps: +1 to 180 days. Legal/compliance will want that. Also need a communications playbook and opt-in sandbox.

Mira: Ok we can make it 180 days. We'll do targeted outreach to top-10 customers and set an admin flag in Console to enable `customer_context`.

Kei: About KMS & immutability: if `customer_context` contains customer-supplied identifiers, do we encrypt that with customer KMS or redact? Current private deployments use customer-managed KMS.

Mira: Implementation notes: in Private deployments we will honor customer KMS for the event store encryption-at-rest. For hosted customers, we will store `customer_context` encrypted with our KMS by default; customers can request encrypted delivery (signed + encrypted webhook payload) using their KMS via a customer HSM contract. We'll document the options.

Olivia: For API consumers who parse `event_type` and `action`, any changes there? We must avoid breaking enums.

Mira: No enum renames. `legacy_action_code` removal is safe because it was deprecated earlier and never used by internal routes for >6 months. We'll keep an alias translator: if v1 payload contains `legacy_action_code`, the v2 `action` will be populated.

Jon: Need concrete examples for QA. Can you paste a sample v2 event?

Mira: Sure — example v2 payload:

```json
{
  "event_schema_version": "2.0.0",
  "event_id": "evt_01F...",
  "timestamp": "2025-11-12T14:22:33Z",
  "event_type": "model.deploy",
  "action": "create",
  "actor": {
    "subject_id": "u_12345",
    "subject_type": "user",
    "display_name": "mira@example.com",
    "ip": "198.51.100.23"
  },
  "resource": {
    "type": "model",
    "id": "mdl_9876",
    "metadata": {"runtime": "v2"}
  },
  "customer_context": {
    "customer_id": "cust-abc",
    "request_id": "r-789"
  }
}
```

Kei: Nice. For contract validation, we should add a JSON Schema and a strict CI check in ingestion repo so invalid events fail build.

Mira: Agreed — I'll add `audit-schema` repo tests and a pre-commit hook. Also plan a nightly compatibility job: take a corpus of 1000 real v1 events, run them through the v2 validator/translator to catch edge cases.

Olivia: What about consumers that rely on message size? `customer_context` can be large. Limit to 8KB and drop if bigger, with a `customer_context_truncated` boolean flag.

Mira: Good call. We'll add `customer_context_size_bytes` and `customer_context_truncated` (bool).

ProductOps: Who's owning the customer opt-in flow & Console toggle? We'll need UI copy and a support playbook to enable/disable per-tenant.

Mira: Assigned to Olivia for Console changes. Support will get step-by-step enabling docs — I'll draft the playbook.

Jon: For rollout tasks, propose checklist: 1) add schema + validator; 2) implement mapper for `actor_id` alias; 3) feature flag to emit v2; 4) internal consumer testing; 5) customer preview; 6) deprecate v1 after 180 days; 7) finalize docs and open source schema.

Mira: I'll make a GH issue and tag owners.

audit-bot: Notice: Created issue #1842 — "audit-schema: v2 rollout plan" (assigns: Mira, Kei, Olivia, Jon).

Kei: One more: logging/monitoring — create metrics: `audit.events.v2_emitted`, `audit.events.validation_failures`, `audit.events.mapper_fallbacks`. Add alert if validation_failures > 0.1% for 5m window.

Mira: Adding metrics and dashboards. Also need a regression test in e2e harness for webhook payloads.

Olivia: I'll coordinate customer comms and schedule the top-10 outreach.

Jon: Thanks — please post the GH issue link here when created and add the schema PR early so we can iterate. :eyes:

Mira: Will do. Posting next steps in the issue and pinging product and cs. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
